headline: Historic win: Bangladesh crowned Women's Junior AHF Cup champions
summary: The U-20 women's hockey team defeated Kazakhstan 2-0 in the final to secure their first-ever international title.
details: Bangladesh's women's U-20 hockey team became unbeaten champions of the Women's Junior AHF Cup after defeating Kazakhstan 2-0 in the final held in Muscat, Oman, on Saturday.
This victory marks the first-ever international title for Bangladesh women's hockey at any level, a landmark achievement for the sport in the country.
The team entered the final with a perfect record, having already beaten Kazakhstan 2-1 in the group stage of the five-team tournament.
Airin Riya, who was later named the tournament's Rising Star, scored the first goal in the 15th minute. Nadira Ema followed with a second goal from a penalty corner four minutes later.
Captain Sharika Rimon was named Player of the Final as the team comfortably held their lead for the remaining three quarters of the match.
Following the final whistle, the players celebrated with expatriate supporters, completing a lap of honour with a giant Bangladesh flag.
caption:
A historic first! Bangladesh women's hockey just secured their first-ever international title.

Bangladesh's women's U-20 hockey team became unbeaten champions of the Women's Junior AHF Cup after defeating Kazakhstan 2-0 in the final held in Muscat, Oman, on Saturday.

This victory marks the first-ever international title for Bangladesh women's hockey at any level, a landmark achievement for the sport in the country.

The team entered the final with a perfect record, having already beaten Kazakhstan 2-1 in the group stage of the five-team tournament.

Airin Riya, who was later named the tournament's Rising Star, scored the first goal in the 15th minute. Nadira Ema followed with a second goal from a penalty corner four minutes later.

Captain Sharika Rimon was named Player of the Final as the team comfortably held their lead for the remaining three quarters of the match.

Following the final whistle, the players celebrated with expatriate supporters, completing a lap of honour with a giant Bangladesh flag.

Source: The Daily Star

headline: Deutsche Bank predicts gold prices could double in 5 years
summary: A new forecast from Deutsche Bank suggests a significant surge in the value of gold over the next five years.
details: Deutsche Bank has released a forecast predicting that the price of gold could double within the next five years.
The global financial institution's analysis suggests a strong upward trend for the precious metal in the coming half-decade.
Gold is often viewed as a safe-haven asset during times of economic uncertainty and geopolitical instability.
This prediction could influence investment strategies for both individual investors and institutional funds worldwide.
